description: Audit the email deliverability and DNS health of one domain or a list of domains before sending cold email from it or to it. Returns one flat, Clay-ready JSON row per domain: SPF, DKIM, and DMARC records with the DMARC policy, MX records and mail provider, DNS blacklist status, catch-all status, domain age, and a 0 to 100 health score. Results are cached for 24 hours per domain; set skipCache to force a fresh audit. It reads public DNS only: it sends no email and does not verify individual mailboxes, so use an email verifier for that. A run that does not succeed is returned as an error with its run ID and status. Read-only; requires an APIFY_TOKEN and consumes Apify credits per call.

attempt_catch_all.description: Set true to run the SMTP catch-all probe. The Apify platform blocks outbound port 25, so on Apify the probe returns unknown; leave it off unless you run the actor where port 25 is open. Default: false.

batchSize.description: How many domains from the list are audited at the same time. Higher finishes a long list sooner. 1 to 10. Default: 5.

domain.description: One bare domain to audit, without https:// or a path, e.g. stripe.com. Provide this or domains.

domains.description: A list of bare domains audited in one run, one row per domain, e.g. ["stripe.com", "notion.so"]. When set, domain is ignored.

skipCache.description: Set true to ignore the 24 hour result cache and audit the domain again now, for example right after a DNS change. Default: false.

name: check_domain_deliverability
title: Check Domain Deliverability
